title: Sugreeva comforts Rama
introduction: Sugreeva comforts Rama, who is tormented with grief, asking him to keep away from apprehensive mind and to think of ways and means to cross the ocean.
closing: इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे आदिकाव्ये युद्धकाण्डे द्वितीयः सर्गः
Thus completes 2nd Chapter of Yuddha Kanda of the glorious Ramayana of Valmiki, the work of a sage and the oldest epic.

verses.devanagari:
तम् तु शोकपरिद्यूनम् रामम् दशरथात्मजम् |
उवाच वचनम् श्रीमान् सुग्रीवह् शोकनाशनम्
verses.iast:
tam tu śokaparidyūnam rāmam daśarathātmajam |
uvāca vacanam śrīmān sugrīvah śokanāśanam
verses.translation: The glorious Sugreeva made the following reply, which was intended to expel his grief, to Rama the son of Dasaratha who felt miserable with anguish.

verses.devanagari:
किम् त्वया तप्यते वीर यथान्यः प्राकृतस्तथा |
मैवम् भूस्त्यज सतापम् कृतघ्न इव सौहृदम्
verses.iast:
kim tvayā tapyate vīra yathānyaḥ prākṛtastathā |
maivam bhūstyaja satāpam kṛtaghna iva sauhṛdam
verses.translation: "Oh, hero! Why are you lamenting thus, as any other ordinary man? Do not be sorrowful like this. Abandon your grief, as an ungrateful man abandons friendship."

glosses.meaning: ordinary man? maa bhuuH = do not be(sorrowful)

verses.devanagari:
सम्तापस्य च ते स्थानम् न हि पश्यामि राघव |
प्रवृत्तामुपलब्धायाम् ज्ञाते च निलये रिपोः
verses.iast:
samtāpasya ca te sthānam na hi paśyāmi rāghava |
pravṛttāmupalabdhāyām jJṇāte ca nilaye ripoḥ
verses.translation: "As the information about Seetha has since been gathered, I do not indeed see any scope for your grief Oh, Rama!"

verses.devanagari:
मतिमान् शास्त्रवित्प्राज्ञः पण्डितश्चासि राघव |
त्यजेमाम् प्राकृताम् उद्धिं कृतात्मेवार्थदूषणीम्
verses.iast:
matimān śāstravitprājJṇḥ paṇḍitaścāsi rāghava |
tyajemām prākṛtām uddhiṃ kṛtātmevārthadūśhaṇīm
verses.translation: "Oh, Rama! You are a wise person, a knower of sacred works, an intellectual and a learned man. Give up these ordinary apprehensions like a man whose spirit is disciplined gives up ideas which spoil the purpose.

glosses.meaning: like giving up conjectures which spoil the purpose
by one whose spirit is disciplined."

verses.devanagari:
संद्रम् लङ्घयित्वा तु महानक्रसमाकुलम् |
लङ्कामारोहयिष्यामो हनिष्यामश्च ते रिपुम्
verses.iast:
saṃdram laṇ^ghayitvā tu mahānakrasamākulam |
laṇ^kāmārohayiśhyāmo haniśhyāmaśca te ripum
verses.translation: "We shall make our way up to Lanka, by crossing the ocean filled with large crocodiles. We shall destroy your enemy."

glosses.meaning: which is filled with large crocodiles

verses.devanagari:
निरुत्साहस्य दीनस्य शोकपर्याकुलात्मनः |
सर्वार्था व्यवसीदन्ति व्यसनम् चाधिगच्छति
verses.iast:
nirutsāhasya dīnasya śokaparyākulātmanaḥ |
sarvārthā vyavasīdanti vyasanam cādhigacchati
verses.translation: "All action get dissipated by a person who is non-enthusiastic, depressed and disturbed with grief. Such a person gets into troubles too."

glosses.meaning: and a person disturbed with grief

verses.devanagari:
इमे शूराः समर्थाश्च सर्वतो हरियूथपाः |
त्वत्प्रियार्थम् कृतोत्साहाः प्रवेष्टुमपि पावकम्
एषाम् हर्षेण जानामि तर्कश्चापि दृढो मम |
verses.iast:
ime śūrāḥ samarthāśca sarvato hariyūthapāḥ |
tvatpriyārtham kṛtotsāhāḥ praveśhṭumapi pāvakam
eśhām harśheṇa jānāmi tarkaścāpi dṛḍho mama |
verses.translation: "These leaders of monkey squads are gallant and efficient in all ways. They are enthusiastic even to enter a fire for your sake. I understand this from their joy and my reasoning too is sound."

verses.devanagari:
विक्रमेण समानेष्ये सीताम् हत्वा यथा रिपुम्
रावनम् पापक्र्माणम् तथा त्वम् कर्तुमर्हसि |
verses.iast:
vikrameṇa samāneśhye sītām hatvā yathā ripum
rāvanam pāpakrmāṇam tathā tvam kartumarhasi |
verses.translation: "You ought to act in every way that I may be able to get back Seetha, after destroying by an attack the enemy Ravana of sinful deeds."

glosses.meaning: I may be able to get back

verses.devanagari:
सेतुरत्र यथा बद्ध्येथा पश्येम ताम् पुरीम्
तस्य राक्षसराजस्य तथा त्वम् कुरु राघव |
verses.iast:
seturatra yathā baddhyethā paśyema tām purīm
tasya rākśasarājasya tathā tvam kuru rāghava |
verses.translation: "You take steps in such a way that a bridge is constructed across the sea and we reach that city of the king of ogres."

verses.devanagari:
दृष्ट्वा ताम् हि पुरीम् लङ्काम् त्रिकूटशिखरे स्थिताम्
हतम् च रावणम् उद्धे दर्शनादवधारय |
verses.iast:
dṛśhṭvā tām hi purīm laṇ^kām trikūṭaśikhare sthitām
hatam ca rāvaṇam uddhe darśanādavadhāraya |
verses.translation: "Be certain that Ravana is killed, once he is seen in a battle and on our seeing that city of Lanka standing on a peak of the Trikuta Mountain."

glosses.meaning: as soon as he is seen
on the peak of Trikuta mountain.

verses.devanagari:
अबद्ध्वा सागरे सेतुम् घोरे च वरुणालये
लङ्का न मर्दितुम् शक्या सेन्द्रैरपि सुरासुरैः |
verses.iast:
abaddhvā sāgare setum ghore ca varuṇālaye
laṇ^kā na marditum śakyā sendrairapi surāsuraiḥ |
verses.translation: "Without building a bridge across the sea, the dreadful abode of Varuna (the god of water), Lanka cannot be defeated even by gods and demons including Indra."

glosses.meaning: abode of Varuna (the god of water)

verses.devanagari:
सेतुर्बद्धः समुद्रे च यावल्लङ्कासमीपतः
सर्वम् तीर्णम् च मे सैन्यम् जितमित्युपधारय |
इमे हि समरे वीरा हरयः कामरूपिणः
verses.iast:
seturbaddhaḥ samudre ca yāvallaṇ^kāsamīpataḥ
sarvam tīrṇam ca me sainyam jitamityupadhāraya |
ime hi samare vīrā harayaḥ kāmarūpiṇaḥ
verses.translation: "Know that when the whole of my army crosses the sea as a bridge is built across it, they will come out victorious, because these monkeys who are able to change their form at will are indeed valiant in battle."

glosses.meaning: who are capable of assuming any form at will

verses.devanagari:
तदलम् विक्लबाम् बुद्धिम् राजन् सर्वार्थनाशनीम् |
पुरुषस्य हि लोकेऽस्मिन् शोकः शौर्यापकर्षणः
verses.iast:
tadalam viklabām buddhim rājan sarvārthanāśanīm |
puruśhasya hi loke'smin śokaḥ śauryāpakarśhaṇaḥ
verses.translation: "Therefore, take away your apprehensive mind, which destroys any enterprise for grief in this world diminishes the might of a man, Oh king!"

verses.devanagari:
यत्तु कार्यम् मनुष्येण शौण्डीर्यमवलम्ब्यताम् |
तदलम्करणायैव कर्तुर्भवति सत्वरम्
verses.iast:
yattu kāryam manuśhyeṇa śauṇḍīryamavalambyatām |
tadalamkaraṇāyaiva karturbhavati satvaram
verses.translation: �Cling to the practice of boldness, ought to be resorted to by a man. It will produce competence without doubt to the doer quickly."

verses.devanagari:
अस्मिन् काले महाप्राज्ञ् सत्त्वमातिष्ठ ते जसा |
शूराणाम् हि मनुष्याणाम् त्वद्विधानाम् महात्मनाम्
विनष्टेवा रनस्स्टे वाशोकः सर्वार्थनाशनः |
verses.iast:
asmin kāle mahāprājJṇ sattvamātiśhṭha te jasā |
śūrāṇām hi manuśhyāṇām tvadvidhānām mahātmanām
vinaśhṭevā ranassṭe vāśokaḥ sarvārthanāśanaḥ |
verses.translation: "Prevail upon the strength with alertness at this moment, Oh highly intelligent prince! Grief for something lost or destroyed consumes all resources of even the strong and magnanimous men like you."

verses.devanagari:
तत्त्वम् बुद्धिमताम् श्रेष्ठह् सर्वशास्त्रर्थकोविदः
मद्विधैः सचिवैः सार्धमरिम् जेतुम् समर्हसि |
verses.iast:
tattvam buddhimatām śreśhṭhah sarvaśāstrarthakovidaḥ
madvidhaiḥ sacivaiḥ sārdhamarim jetum samarhasi |
verses.translation: "You are the foremost among the intelligent and the knower of all sacred texts. Hence, you ought to defeat the enemy, with allies like me."

glosses.meaning: the knower of all sacred texts

verses.devanagari:
न हि पश्याम्यहम् कम् चित्त्रिषु लोकेषु राघव
गृहीतधनुषो यस्ते तिष्ठे दभिमुखो रणे |
verses.iast:
na hi paśyāmyaham kam cittriśhu lokeśhu rāghava
gṛhītadhanuśho yaste tiśhṭhe dabhimukho raṇe |
verses.translation: "I do not indeed see any one who can withstand you in a battle filed in the three worlds, when you are armed with a bow, Oh Rama!"

verses.devanagari:
वानरेषु समासक्तम् न ते कार्यम् विपत्स्यते
अचिराद्द्रक्ष्यसे सीताम् तीर्त्वा सागरमक्षयम् |
verses.iast:
vānareśhu samāsaktam na te kāryam vipatsyate
acirāddrakśyase sītām tīrtvā sāgaramakśayam |
verses.translation: "You work duly entrusted to the monkeys will not be spoiled. You shall behold Seetha era imperishable sea."

verses.devanagari:
तदलम् शोकमालम्ब्य क्रोधमालम्ब भूपते
निश्चेष्टाह् क्षत्रिया मन्दाः सर्वे चण्डस्य् बिभ्यति |
verses.iast:
tadalam śokamālambya krodhamālamba bhūpate
niśceśhṭāh kśatriyā mandāḥ sarve caṇḍasy bibhyati |
verses.translation: "Oh, Lord of the earth! Desist from this melancholy. Yield to your legitimate indignation. Unadventurous Kshatriyas (members of warrior-tribe) never win honor but all fear the wrathful."

verses.devanagari:
लङ्घानार्थम् च घोरस्य समुद्रस्य नदीपतेः
सहास्माभिरिहोओपेतह् सूक्ष्मबुद्धिर्विचारय |
verses.iast:
laṇ^ghānārtham ca ghorasya samudrasya nadīpateḥ
sahāsmābhirihoopetah sūkśmabuddhirvicāraya |
verses.translation: "You with your resourceful mind, along with us together, ponder over now a design to cross the sea, the terrible Lord of rivers."

verses.devanagari:
लङ्घिते तत्र तैः सैन्यैर्जितमित्येव निश्चिनु
सर्वम् तीर्णम् च मे सैन्यम् जितमित्यवधार्यताम् |
verses.iast:
laṇ^ghite tatra taiḥ sainyairjitamityeva niścinu
sarvam tīrṇam ca me sainyam jitamityavadhāryatām |
verses.translation: "Know victory to be certain, once the sea has been crossed by the army. Verily when all my forces have passed over the sea our triumph is assured!"

verses.devanagari:
इमे हि हरयः शूराः समरे कामरूपिणः
तानरीन्विधमिष्यन्ति शिलापादपवृष्टिभिः |
verses.iast:
ime hi harayaḥ śūrāḥ samare kāmarūpiṇaḥ
tānarīnvidhamiśhyanti śilāpādapavṛśhṭibhiḥ |
verses.translation: "These monkeys, the courageous soldiers who are able to change their form at their volition, will crush their opponents with an avalanche of rocks and trees."

glosses.meaning: and capable of assuming any form at will
by a shower of rocks and trees.

verses.devanagari:
कथम् चित्परिपश्यामि लङ्घितम् वरुणालयम्
हतमित्येव तम् मन्ये युद्धे शत्रुनिबर्हण |
verses.iast:
katham citparipaśyāmi laṇ^ghitam varuṇālayam
hatamityeva tam manye yuddhe śatrunibarhaṇa |
verses.translation: "Once we have crossed the sea (the abode of Varuna) by whatever the means employed, Ravana is as definitely killed in my eyes, Oh exterminator of enemies!"

verses.devanagari:
किमुक्त्वा बहुधा चापि सर्वथा विजया भवान्
निमित्तानि च पश्यामि मनो मे सम्प्रहृष्यति |
verses.iast:
kimuktvā bahudhā cāpi sarvathā vijayā bhavān
nimittāni ca paśyāmi mano me samprahṛśhyati |
verses.translation: What is the use of all these words? By all means, you will be a victorious man. I see good omens and my heard is over thrilled with joy."

glosses.meaning: at length? bhavaan = you will be
